notes.subject: ענג / תתענג
notes.rationale: פרז 13 'ענג' (switpela samting) i kamap בפרז 14 'תתענג' (yu swit long Yahwe) — wankain rut, isi no kamap insait long Tok Pisin

notes.subject: נחלת
notes.rationale: samting bilong ol i ken kaikai — inheritance; 'givim kaikai bilong' em i tok bilongפרז, no exact

notes.subject: yu
notes.rationale: Yahwe i toktok direkt long man bilong ol nem, promis long em

translation: Na taim olsem, bai yu	swit long Yahwe, na bai mi salim yu go long ol haus bilong ol bikpela hil long graun, na bai mi givim kaikai bilong olgeta samting bilong Yakov, papa bilong yu, long yu, bilong ol i ken kaikai; long wanem mouth bilong Yahwe i tokaut pinis.
